name: reuse-prompted-connection-by-id

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/device_login_test.go — TestTheSamePrincipalReusesAPromptedConnectionByIDWithNoCredential: the reuse is 201 on the prompted connection, no stored credential resolved, no vault touched

description: A connection opened by a device login may carry another session for the principal that opened it, named by `connection_id` on a `reuse` create that carries no login (session-open step 4; Contract §15.3: reusing the connection reuses the authentication, so a TACACS+ or one-time-code login is paid once). The core resolves no stored credential for it, touches no vault, and opens the session on that connection. Here `fixture-conn-1` is a connection a device login opened for this principal. The record keeps `credential_ref` `supplied` and carries `login: prompted` (C6/connection-record-login), which is what lets this reuse survive a core restart. A connection opened with a supplied login stays never reusable.

recording.warning_text: This session is recorded byte-perfect. Anything typed will be stored as-is.
